title: Google\Cloud\Spanner\Session\CacheSessionPool
name: CacheSessionPool
description: This session pool implementation accepts a PSR-6 compatible cache implementation and utilizes it to store sessions between requests.

params.name: cacheItemPool
params.description: A PSR-6 compatible cache implementation used to store the session data.

params.name: config.maxSessions
params.description: The maximum number of sessions to store in the pool. Defaults to 500.

params.name: config.minSessions
params.description: The minimum number of sessions to store in the pool. Defaults to 1.

params.name: config.shouldWaitForSession
params.description: If the pool is full, whether to block until a new session is available. *Defaults to true.

params.name: config.maxCyclesToWaitForSession
params.description: The maximum number cycles to wait for a session before throwing an exception. Defaults to 30. Ignored when $shouldWaitForSession is false.

params.name: config.sleepIntervalSeconds
params.description: The sleep interval between cycles. Defaults to 0.5. Ignored when $shouldWaitForSession is false.

params.name: config.lock
params.description: A lock implementation capable of blocking. Defaults to a semaphore based implementation if the required extensions are installed, otherwise an flock based implementation.

params.name: config.shouldAutoDownsize
params.description: Determines whether or not to automatically attempt to downsize the pool after every 10 minute window. Defaults to true.

params.name: config.labels
params.description: Labels to be applied to each session created in the pool. Label keys must be between 1 and 63 characters long and must conform to the following regular expression: [a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?. Label values must be between 0 and 63 characters long and must conform to the regular expression ([a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)?. No more than 64 labels can be associated with a given session. See https://goo.gl/xmQnxf for more information on and examples of labels.

params.name: context
params.description: The type of session to fetch. May be either r (READ) or rw (READ/WRITE). Defaults to r.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Release a session back to the pool.

methods.name: downsize
methods.description: Downsizes the queue of available sessions by the given percentage. This is relative to the minimum sessions value. For example: Assuming a full queue, with maximum sessions of 10 and a minimum of 2, downsizing by 50% would leave 6 sessions in the queue. The count of items to be deleted will be rounded up in the case of a fraction.

params.name: percent
params.description: The percentage to downsize the pool by. Must be between 1 and 100.

returns.description: The number of sessions removed from the pool.

methods.name: warmup
methods.description: Create enough sessions to meet the minimum session constraint.

returns.description: The number of sessions created and added to the queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear the cache and attempt to delete all sessions in the pool.

methods.name: setDatabase
methods.description: Set the database used to make calls to manage sessions.

methods.name: maintain
methods.description: Maintain queued sessions for selected database and keep them alive.
